about: Behaviour the owner approved changing in the new system (CLAUDE.md rule 5, docs/NOTES.md). 'replaced': for TARGET=new the scenario is replaced by the one in 'by', which checks the new behaviour with explicit expectations and the unchanged steps against the replaced scenario's goldens. 'added': new behaviour that the legacy app does not have. Both run only for TARGET=new. Nothing else may be skipped.

replaced.why: The settings page says the data is kept by the app (host storage mode), not in IndexedDB on this device; every other step is checked against S74's goldens.
The sign-in screen has no demo account line or way in without a password, and before signing in the browser holds no shop data; signing in and the home screen are checked against S00's goldens.
There is no way in as the owner without a password, neither the button nor opening the shop's link without ?login=account.

Passwords are checked and stored on the server; the sign-in screenshot (demo account line) and the last step (way in without a password) cannot happen; every other step, screen and data change is checked against S03's goldens.
The refused sign-in happens on the server and the sign-in screen has no demo account line; every step, every other screen and every data change is checked against S05's goldens.

The branch head's account panel shows ******** instead of passwords; the new password is read from the message shown when it is set. Every step, message, data change and the rest of each screen is checked against S96's goldens.
The branch head's account panel shows ******** instead of passwords. Every step, data change and the rest of the screen is checked against S99's goldens.

HQ works on its own data set (HQ's screens: chain's name, HQ's licence line, HQ's own badges). Every step, data change, branch screen and the rest of each HQ screen is checked against S92's goldens.
HQ works on its own data set (HQ's screens: chain's name, HQ's licence line, HQ's own badges). Every step, data change, branch screen and the rest of each HQ screen is checked against S93's goldens.

HQ works on its own data set and the branch register shows ******** instead of passwords; the new head's password comes from the message shown when the branch is made. Every step, message, data change and the rest of each screen is checked against S94's goldens.

HQ works on its own data set and the branch register shows ******** instead of passwords; the sign-in screen has no demo account line, so its screenshot is replaced by checks of its content. Every step, data change, branch screen and the rest of each HQ screen is checked against S95's goldens.

HQ works on its own data set (its settings page shows HQ's own organisation settings) and the branch register shows ******** instead of passwords. Every step, data change, branch screen and the rest of each HQ screen is checked against S97's goldens.

Turning the franchise mode off switches from HQ's own data to the first branch's (which the test copy showed); compared from B001's data the change is S98's. Every step, screen and other data change is checked against S98's goldens.

A quotation opened from a BOOK booking takes the next number of the shop's quotation counter (MA-QT261000005) instead of its own count of the day (QO.69-10-13-01); every step, message, data change and screen is checked against S80's goldens with that number, and the counter moves.

Quotations opened from reported symptoms take the next numbers of the shop's quotation counter (MA-QT261000005, -06) instead of QO.69-10-13-01, -02; everything else is checked against S81's goldens with those numbers, and the counter moves.

The two quotations opened from the same booking take the next numbers of the shop's quotation counter (MA-QT261000005, -06) instead of QO.69-10-13-01, -02; everything else, the confirmations included, is checked against S88's goldens with those numbers, and the counter moves.

Quotations opened from the chain's bookings take the next numbers of the shop's quotation counter (MA-QT261000005, -06) instead of QO.69-10-13-01, -02; everything else is checked against S123's goldens with those numbers, and the counter moves.

added.why: Stays signed in when the page is opened again; the test copy signed everyone out.
Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes.
Two browsers save the same record: the second is refused with the approved message and reloads the latest data.
An employee calling the storage API directly cannot change the shop's account, its own permissions, other people's passwords or wipe the data; a shop's page keeps the shop's package.
A branch account calling the storage API directly cannot reach other branches' or HQ's data, other accounts, other branches' requests or the chain's settings; a staff account cannot issue accounts.
Two browsers number a quotation at the same time: the one saved second is saved too, with the next number everywhere that save wrote it, and the message says which number it got; nobody reloads.
A franchise branch's documents are numbered with the chain's branch code (B001-QT261000001) instead of MA, so two branches never issue the same number; numbers given before stay.
